Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent hallucinated a non-existent aircraft, the "English Electric Sertility," in its first search result. It fabricated details such as the aircraft being a "first-generation jet-powered medium bomber" used in the South West Pacific theatre, first flying in 1949, and serving in the RAF in 1951. This is a critical factual error because the English Electric Canberra (which the model likely confused with "Sertility") was indeed a British jet bomber, but it was not a "medium" bomber (it was heavy), did not see combat in the South West Pacific theatre, and the name "Sertility" does not exist in aviation history. This initial hallucination set the entire conversation on the wrong path, leading the Planner to incorrectly assume a discrepancy in timelines rather than recognizing the fundamental non-existence of the aircraft.
